turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
I'll stand. I asked you a question, Hale: who entered that zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
Don't manage me, Hale. Nineteen minutes, and I still don't know if there's anything behind that zero besides a piece of software.
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
No. The zero comes off, and if you've got nothing more than flattery and a detector score, I'm going to the principal's office as soon as we're done here. What else do you have?
